## How to cite

If you use materials from this course in your work, please cite:

> MFIIDD course contributors (2026).
> MFIIDD: Model Fitting and Inference for Infectious Disease Dynamics.
> URL: <https://mfiidd.github.io/mfiidd/>

- [Report issues or suggest improvements](https://github.com/mfiidd/mfiidd/issues)

## History

The course was originally developed in 2014 at the Centre for the Mathematical Modelling of Infectious Diseases (CMMID) at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine.
Anton Camacho and Sebastian Funk wrote the first version in R, which is [archived on GitHub](https://github.com/sbfnk/mfiidd.archive).

We rewrote the course in Julia in 2026.
We have borrowed elements of the structure, presentation and framing of this site from [NFIDD](https://nfidd.github.io/nfidd/), a course on nowcasting and forecasting infectious disease dynamics (MIT licensed).
